purpose: Reviewed photo action layout and read-only shared memo projection. The same visible photo remains bound to favorite, private memo, send and related-photo actions. Delivery captions and existing same-space/same-moment active words share the photo footer; sent captions retain their original author. Reading performs no record creation. Existing photo entries, including withdrawn photos, retain active words and explicit additions without photo re-upload. Only the current author may edit their words; existing permission, lifecycle, revision, persistence, delivery and identity contracts remain unchanged. Eight existing native operations and all mandatory safety jobs remain required; this is not a general UI exemption. The reviewed repair owns memo state and sheets above the adaptive footer in received, sent and fixture photo screens, preserving the editor during keyboard layout changes. Caption-only sources perform no record load. The private-note test uses system Select All; the shared-note test verifies keyboard focus before typing. The editor destination also captures its source at opening so a later caption-only state cannot replace an unsaved editor with an empty sheet; existing save validation remains authoritative.
